problems: Row 4 "star promenade left ½ no butterfly twirl but promenade right to new couple to face across · slide" can't start from where the dancers are: Dancer 0 (couple 1) must stand on a side line.

Row 1 "balance and robins shift left in center · slide" can't start from where the dancers are: No robins to slide.
choices: A balance with a partner or neighbor holds both hands.
